edits.descriptionKo: 왼쪽 멀리 둥근 건물의 탑이 없어졌어요.
edits.instructionEn: Remove the small distant domed building silhouette on the left and restore the hazy sky.

edits.descriptionKo: 가운데 왼쪽 말의 안장 천이 파란색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor the small patterned saddle blanket on the brown horse near x29 y55 to blue, retaining its pattern and edges.

edits.descriptionKo: 말을 잡은 사람의 올린 소매가 붉게 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor only the raised turquoise sleeve of the central-left horse handler near x37 y40 to burgundy; preserve hands and face.

edits.descriptionKo: 흰 말 뒤 사람의 저고리가 보라색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor the visible green jacket of the man behind the central white horse around x52 y47 to purple.

edits.descriptionKo: 오른쪽 기수의 흰 셔츠가 파란색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor the white shirt of the rider facing away near x63 y47 to blue, keeping arms, pose, horses and all folds.

edits.descriptionKo: 오른쪽 끝 사람의 겉옷이 붉은색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor only the green jacket of the far-right foreground rider near x92 y52 to muted red.
Recolor the dark trousers of the foreground handler at x24 y70 to blue, preserving silhouette and folds.

edits.descriptionKo: 오른쪽 나무의 작은 잎 무리가 노란색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Turn one discrete cluster of green leaves near x75 y24 to golden yellow; keep tree branches unchanged.

edits.descriptionKo: 오른쪽 뒤 관객의 작은 챙모자가 붉은색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor the small light brimmed hat of a background spectator near x84 y47 to red, preserving their face.

edits.descriptionKo: 왼쪽 끝 사람의 모자가 파란색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor the dark round hat of the left foreground person near x8 y49 to blue; preserve head and posture.
